name: ShipLog: build-in-public posts from your commits
tagline: Paste this week's commits. Get an X post, a LinkedIn post and a changelog, with every number checked against your log.
description:
ShipLog is for solo builders who ship every week but never find time to write about it.

Paste this week's commit lines (the output of git log --oneline works) or a few bullet notes, or import the last 7 days from a public GitHub repository. ShipLog writes three drafts you can post right away:

• an X post that always fits 280 characters
• a LinkedIn update with the changes people will notice
• a changelog entry grouped into Added, Changed, Fixed, Performance and Docs

How it works
1. ShipLog reads your notes first, without AI: it sorts every line into features, fixes, speed-ups and releases, and skips noise like merges, dependency bumps and typo fixes.
2. Anna AI writes the three drafts from that digest only, in the tone you pick (build in public, professional or technical) and in one of 9 languages.
3. ShipLog checks every number in the drafts against what you pasted. Numbers found in your log are marked in blue; anything that isn't gets marked in amber and ShipLog asks the model to fix it once before showing you the result.

Every run is saved to your own Anna storage, so you can reopen past weeks and keep a weekly streak going.

Privacy: your notes and drafts are stored only in your Anna account. Drafts are written by the Anna AI model you use, on your Anna credits or your own key. The optional GitHub import calls api.github.com from your browser for public repositories only. ShipLog has no server of its own and collects no analytics.
changelog: First release: X post, LinkedIn post and changelog from your commits or notes; number check against your log; import from a public GitHub repo; 3 tones and 9 output languages; weekly history and streak.
